verdict.rationale: Mail import and migration is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows Zero connecting to existing providers such as Gmail and Outlook and caching their mail. That is live account access, not a documented import of mail history and contacts from an old provider or client. No import or migration tool and no contacts import is documented.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
